title: Networked Client-Server Application reference design
architecture: Keep domain types and core rules separate from console/file/network/UI adapters.
Use standard containers and RAII-owned resources unless a measured requirement justifies a lower-level abstraction.
Represent invalid states and failures explicitly; do not silently ignore failed I/O or dependency operations.
implementation_plan: Add timeout and connection failure handling
Test malformed messages and concurrent clients
test_plan: I/O or dependency failure where relevant
expected_quality: Develop a small application in which clients communicate with a server. Include a README, explicit C++ standard and build commands, known limitations, and reproducible test results.
explanation: This reference design shows a review path for Networked Client-Server Application; it is not represented as a complete source implementation. Fill in and review the domain-specific implementation and tests before publication.
